cast.design: A relaxed, bright-voiced woman in her late twenties with a Brisbane Australian accent, easy and confident.
cast.style: Breezy, a grin in the voice; would rather be flying than talking.
cast.sample: Every gunner gets a go in a fighter. Take any of them on the pads. Launch, fly about, then fly yourself home down the lane of rings. Don't call flight control to bring you in: fly it.
